title: Avelune entry-point manifest
description: Declares the layer and the size budget of one @avelune/ui secondary entry point. An entry point may import only entry points of its own or a lower layer (ADR 0001); ui:size fails when its bundle exceeds the budget (ADR 0028).

layer.description: Layers from lowest to highest: foundations, components, composites, patterns.

sizeLimit.description: Budget for the entry point's bundle, minified and brotli-compressed, peers and other entry points excluded: the measured size plus 10%, rounded up to the next 100 B (ADR 0028).
